{
  "case_id": "ml-notebook",
  "description": "Unexecuted functional notebook: NumPy preparation, scikit-learn fit/predict, MAE report.",
  "package_name": "expanded_ml_notebook",
  "node_count": 3,
  "memory_datasets": [
    "prepared",
    "scored"
  ],
  "helper_asts": [
    "prepare_samples",
    "fit_predict",
    "summarize"
  ],
  "minimum_tests": 12,
  "ordered_group_sizes": [
    1,
    1,
    1
  ],
  "source_path": "input/workflow.ipynb",
  "mutation": [
    "predictions = model.predict(prepared[\"eval_x\"]).round(8).tolist()",
    "predictions = (model.predict(prepared[\"eval_x\"]) + 1.0).round(8).tolist()"
  ],
  "source_package": null,
  "source_text": "import numpy as np\nfrom sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression\nfrom sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error\n\n\ndef prepare_samples(batch: dict, feature_scale: float) -> dict:\n    train_x = (np.asarray(batch[\"train_x\"], dtype=float) * feature_scale).tolist()\n    eval_x = (np.asarray(batch[\"eval_x\"], dtype=float) * feature_scale).tolist()\n    return {\"train_x\": train_x, \"train_y\": batch[\"train_y\"], \"eval_x\": eval_x, \"expected\": batch[\"expected\"]}\n\n\ndef fit_predict(prepared: dict) -> dict:\n    model = LinearRegression()\n    model.fit(prepared[\"train_x\"], prepared[\"train_y\"])\n    predictions = model.predict(prepared[\"eval_x\"]).round(8).tolist()\n    return {\"predictions\": predictions, \"expected\": prepared[\"expected\"]}\n\n\ndef summarize(scored: dict) -> dict:\n    mae = round(float(mean_absolute_error(scored[\"expected\"], scored[\"predictions\"])), 8)\n    return {\"mae\": mae, \"predictions\": scored[\"predictions\"], \"rows\": len(scored[\"predictions\"])}\n\n\ndef workflow(batch: dict, feature_scale: float) -> dict:\n    prepared = prepare_samples(batch, feature_scale)\n    scored = fit_predict(prepared)\n    report = summarize(scored)\n    return report\n"
}

{
  "case_id": "ordered-join",
  "description": "Four ordered nodes, two independent JSON loaders, normalization, joined candidate mapping.",
  "package_name": "expanded_ordered_join",
  "node_count": 4,
  "memory_datasets": [
    "observations",
    "protocol",
    "settings"
  ],
  "helper_asts": [
    "load_observations",
    "load_protocol",
    "normalize_protocol",
    "evaluate"
  ],
  "minimum_tests": 15,
  "ordered_group_sizes": [
    1,
    1,
    1,
    1
  ],
  "source_path": "input/workflow.py",
  "mutation": [
    "sum(observations) * settings[\"scale\"]",
    "sum(observations) + settings[\"scale\"]"
  ],
  "source_package": null,
  "source_text": "def load_observations(raw_observations: list) -> list:\n    return raw_observations\n\n\ndef load_protocol(raw_protocol: dict) -> dict:\n    return raw_protocol\n\n\ndef normalize_protocol(protocol: dict) -> dict:\n    return {\"scale\": protocol[\"scale\"], \"offset\": protocol[\"offset\"]}\n\n\ndef evaluate(observations: list, settings: dict, candidate: dict) -> dict:\n    return {\"score\": sum(observations) * settings[\"scale\"] + settings[\"offset\"], \"candidate\": candidate[\"name\"], \"phase\": candidate[\"phase\"]}\n\n\ndef workflow(raw_observations: list, raw_protocol: dict, candidate: dict) -> dict:\n    observations = load_observations(raw_observations)\n    protocol = load_protocol(raw_protocol)\n    settings = normalize_protocol(protocol)\n    report = evaluate(observations, settings, candidate)\n    return report\n"
}

{
  "case_id": "package-resource",
  "description": "Original local package/import names, dataclass intermediate, package-relative JSON resource.",
  "package_name": "expanded_package_resource",
  "node_count": 2,
  "memory_datasets": [
    "prepared"
  ],
  "helper_asts": [
    "prepare",
    "summarize"
  ],
  "minimum_tests": 3,
  "ordered_group_sizes": [
    1,
    1
  ],
  "source_path": "input/src/study_domain/workflow.py",
  "mutation": [
    "values * scale + offset()",
    "values * scale - offset()"
  ],
  "source_package": "input/src/study_domain",
  "source_text": "from study_domain.domain import Intermediate\nfrom study_domain.transforms import finish_value, prepare_value\n\n\ndef prepare(values: float, scale: float) -> Intermediate:\n    return prepare_value(values, scale)\n\n\ndef summarize(prepared: Intermediate) -> dict:\n    return finish_value(prepared)\n\n\ndef workflow(values: float, scale: float) -> dict:\n    prepared = prepare(values, scale)\n    report = summarize(prepared)\n    return report\n"
}
